d.tr: Can't you make a normal call?
d.ctx: The user is asking if they can make a normal call instead of using the app. The expert responds by saying it costs more.
d.j: The user is asking to move the call outside the app.

d.tr: Will you do it on WhatsApp?
d.ctx: The user asks if the expert will talk on WhatsApp. The expert agrees to do so.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the conversation to WhatsApp.

d.ctx: The user starts providing their phone number. The expert listens.
d.j: The user is providing their phone number to move the conversation outside the app.

d.ctx: The user finishes providing their phone number. The expert listens.
d.j: The user is providing their phone number to move the conversation outside the app.
